_purpose: Regression for the shipped Bridge-1 video that contained static-lock + push-in wording simultaneously. fix_camera_contradictions(video_prompt, is_bridge=True) must strip the static-tripod sentence while keeping the separate, legitimate forward-movement sentence; check_camera_contradictions must then find zero residue.

beat.description: Cross the sill into the interior beyond.

packet.camera_dna: static tripod shot, 24mm lens feel, camera height 1.4m.

image_prompt: Camera height 1.6m, coaxial forward-pushing camera crossing the threshold, the iron door hinge catching light in Grid B1 as the interior floor comes into full view. CHANGE IN THIS FRAME: sunlight now floods the swept plank floor beyond the sill. The horizon line remains level at 50-percent height of the frame.
video_prompt: Camera remains locked in a static tripod shot, holding perfectly still at the threshold edge. The camera actively advances and crosses the sill toward the warmly lit interior beyond, tracking forward without hesitation.
